| description = Placeholders are a goblin lookout, a goblin sentry, a goblin veteran. There are two identical spawn cycles at this spawn point. One is 72 minutes, one is 6 minutes; both can be up at the same time. The alchemist is on the 72 minute cycle. <br><br> The goblins on this cycle spawn at the fork just outside Runnyeye. They move west immediately on spawn stopping at (635, -1471) then continue west stopping again at (788, -1006). Then the goblins turn back east stopping once again at the mid-point before returning to spawn. Upon return to spawn point they immediately turn west starting the circuit again. One circuit takes about 4 minutes. There are other wandering goblins that move through this area but any goblin that turns the corner by the spawn point is NOT part of this spawn cycle.
